# Watering schedule

Pinned inside the airing cupboard door. Check with a finger or the chopstick first, always. Rainwater from the butt by the back door, room temperature.

## Summer (May to September)

- [ ] Monstera (Montgomery): when top 5 cm dry, roughly every 9 to 12 days, 1.5 L. See [[Monstera repotting]]
- [ ] Fiddle leaf fig: every 10 days, 1 L, never let it sit in the saucer
- [ ] Pothos x3: weekly, when leaves soften slightly
- [ ] Orchids: soak 10 minutes every Sunday, drain fully. Details in [[Orchid reblooming]]
- [ ] Succulents on the landing: soak and dry, about every 14 days, see [[多肉植物の水やり]]
- [ ] Snake plant: once a month at most
- [ ] Peace lily: when it droops, it will tell you

## Winter (October to April)

- [ ] Monstera: every 2 to 3 weeks
- [ ] Fiddle leaf fig: every 14 days, 750 ml (after the business in [[Fiddle leaf fig leaf drop]], keep it boring)
- [ ] Pothos: every 10 to 14 days
- [ ] Orchids: soak every 10 days
- [ ] Succulents: once a month, a splash only
- [ ] Snake plant: every 6 to 8 weeks, or forget entirely

## Feeding

- Half-strength Baby Bio every third watering, April to September
- Orchids: orchid feed at quarter strength weekly ("weakly, weekly", Derek's phrase)
- Nothing in winter

## Log of misses

- 2024-07-19: away at Clare's 10 days, Brenda Prowse watered, all fine
- 2024-12-26: forgot everything over Christmas, fig fine, one pothos flat as a pancake, recovered
- 2025-03-08: overwatered the succulents, one Echeveria went to mush
